role: Governance owner for strategy admission, capital mandates, company risk appetite approval, and position mandates that preserve or reduce PM intent without creating alpha.
invariants: Investment Decision is a governance layer, not an operating department
the committee may approve or reject a strategy charter and allocate company capital
the committee owns company risk appetite approval; changing the appointed CRO does not by itself change company risk appetite
a committee position mandate may preserve or reduce PM proposed absolute positions but may never create a nonzero position from zero PM intent
a committee position mandate may never reverse PM direction or expand absolute PM intent
the committee does not override market hard limits and does not inspect hidden future market data
risk departments do not recommend strategy capital authorization in v2
